original_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / character production reference. Ryan Blake. Input Image 1 is the user-approved facial master and SOLE identity/skin/hair/rendering reference.
ONE landscape acting reference sheet EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows of six close head-and-shoulder portraits. Every face STRICT FRONT at EYE LEVEL, horizontal pupils, zero tilt, identical camera, same hair, same face geometry and costume. Only facial muscles change. Top row: NEUTRAL (relaxed mouth/brows), SMILE (clear warm natural smile and soft eyes), CONCERNED (inner brows lifted, attentive worried eyes). Bottom row: SURPRISED (raised brows, wider eyes, slightly parted lips), SAD (soft lowered gaze still facing front, inner brow tension, downturned lip corners), FIRM (lowered brows, focused gaze, lightly pressed lips, controlled displeasure). Six clearly different, believable adult emotions, no cartoon exaggeration, no identity drift. Do not replace expressions with different viewing angles.
Identity and approved costume: Adult early twenties man, textured tousled auburn brown short hair, warm hazel eyes, light freckles across nose/cheeks, no beard. Same open dark indigo short-sleeve mechanic work shirt with charcoal collar, brass buttons and small brass buckles over black crew-neck tee, loose washed charcoal-black jeans and black work boots. Enthusiastic but adult.
Style: preserve the original premium Vicky otome semi-realistic 2.5D/3D finish, modeled facial planes, precise realistic eye shapes, natural skin detail and fine individual hair strands, rich but soft studio lighting. Do not beautify into a generic face or switch to cel anime, photograph, sketch or low-detail plastic.
Clean seamless pure white background. Landscape 1536x1024 composition with evenly aligned views, no cut-off hair/feet, no extra panels, no titles or logos, no decorative frames, no accessories/props not in source. Small unobtrusive English view/emotion labels below each view are allowed only; do not put text over the character. Keep the person's exact eye spacing, nose, mouth, jaw, age, complexion and identifying marks.
